title: SM-16.09 - What ongoing EU-funded projects should do during the transition
intent: This article answers: SM-16.09 - What ongoing EU-funded projects should do during the transition
short_answer: EU-funded projects are not automatically exempt. If a survey is owned by an external user, it follows the same transition timeline. To continue using EUSurvey beyond the transition period, the survey should be transferred to an EU institutional account or created under EU institutional ownership with appropriate permissions for external project users.
important_conditions: Project coordinators should review ownership and permissions early.
